summary: v1.9 iteration tested: Terminal page (rewritten hands-free CLI) + Scheduler AlertDialog delete confirmation. Backend: 8/8 new v19 terminal endpoint tests passing (whoami, scans, scan create+poll+complete on 127.0.0.1 fast, summary, nmap-xml, cancel, chat). Regression: 23/23 v17+v18 tests passing. Frontend Playwright end-to-end: help lists all 9 verbs, whoami/scans/unknown-command outputs, ArrowUp/ArrowDown history recall (including clearing on past-end), full scan lifecycle on 127.0.0.1 completing within ~60s with % progress lines and 'Scan completed' terminator, ai query rendered as purple ai line. Scheduler: delete button now opens AlertDialog; cancel preserves item; confirm fires DELETE, removes item, decrements count (2→1).
critical_code_review_comments: TerminalPage.js polling loop uses fixed 2s * 150 iters (~5min) — reasonable, but no cancellation on component unmount; navigating away during a scan leaves an orphaned poll loop that will still call push() via setState on unmounted component (React will warn). Consider AbortController or an isMounted ref.
TerminalPage.js history state (cmdHistory) is not persisted across page navigations — acceptable per spec, but noted.

SchedulerPage.js pendingDelete stores the whole schedule object; if the schedules list refetches while dialog is open, pendingDelete could reference a stale record. Not a bug in practice given short interaction window.
TerminalPage runScan: setLoading disables input during long scans (~30–60s), preventing users from queuing other commands — this is a UX trade-off, arguably desired to avoid interleaved output.
seed_data_creation: Two ephemeral schedules (TEST_v19_del, TEST_v19_keep) created and cleaned up during Playwright run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v1.9 = frontend-only iteration. TerminalPage.js has data-testids: terminal-page, terminal-container, terminal-output, terminal-input, terminal-submit, terminal-line-{system|input|output|error|ai}. SchedulerPage.js delete flow: schedule-delete-<id> opens delete-schedule-dialog with delete-schedule-cancel and delete-schedule-confirm. Backend endpoints unchanged from v1.8. Auth via localStorage 'token' + axios.defaults Authorization.
